About this site

Zucchini is a wallet project focused on self-custody and shielded Zcash payments. This website provides project information and links to software under active development. Descriptions do not guarantee availability, suitability, security or future features.

Using wallet software

Review the software’s setup instructions and applicable license before use. You are responsible for keeping recovery material secure and checking transaction details. Blockchain transactions may be irreversible. This website does not accept deposits, hold wallet keys or recover lost recovery phrases.
